results.title: Homeric Atlas
results.summary: A probabilistic map of where the episodes of the Iliad and the Odyssey might have happened — each location classed as accepted, plausible, speculative or mythical, scored 0–12 against a published rubric, with sources, rival theories and reusable JSON/GeoJSON.

results.title: Agentic control sandbox
results.summary: Interactive sandbox: configure an agent on six axes, pick an OWASP LLM Top 10 threat, switch the eighteen controls of the Agentic Control Matrix on and off, and read the coverage — quadrants filled, quadrants left empty, frameworks answered. Deliberately without a residual-risk score.

results.title: Taxonomy of autonomous agents
results.summary: An interactive taxonomy that encodes 24 AI agents — from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, Amazon and SpaceXAI to the open-source frontier — as vectors across six orthogonal axes plus an action surface, with a filterable table, an A×T×I governance-risk matrix and a machine-readable JSON API.

results.title: The real economics of an AI agent
results.summary: Estimate monthly operating cost, cost per correct outcome, savings, ROI and break-even from workload volume, token prices, tools, retries, human review and rework.

results.title: How many evaluations do I need?
results.summary: Calculate how many cases you need to detect at least one failure at a chosen confidence level and to estimate its frequency with an explicit margin.

results.title: Human oversight capacity
results.summary: Size review hours, escalations, FTE, cost, sustainable volume and backlog before putting an AI system into production.

results.title: Use case → agentic vector
results.summary: Classify a system across six behavioural axes and its action surfaces, estimate its governance-risk band, surface control signals and find its nearest neighbours among 24 mapped agents.

results.title: Control and framework translator
results.summary: Crosswalk the 18 Agentic Control Matrix controls to the EU AI Act, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS—with an explicit caveat: mapping is not compliance.

results.title: LLM context in human terms
results.summary: Convert tokens into words, pages, documents, reading and speaking minutes, context-window usage and approximate input cost.

results.title: Close the gap
results.summary: A five-round educational game: choose the right governance controls under a limited budget, close each agent's essential gaps and learn from immediate explanations.

results.title: Model, agent or harness?
results.summary: Twelve cases to distinguish the base capability, the entity pursuing goals and the infrastructure connecting context, memory, tools and controls.

results.title: Benchmark detective
results.summary: Investigate AI claims, choose the evidence that actually tests them and spot saturation, contamination, uncertainty and misleading metrics.

results.title: World exam challenge
results.summary: A twelve-round game about 18 university-entrance systems: compare demandingness, identify countries and separate cognitive profile from selective pressure.

results.title: The professions most exposed to AI
results.summary: An interactive map of the 22 occupational groups, comparing AI's theoretical capability against its observed real-world use (as of June 2026), with a category ranking, the most-exposed occupations and the macro figures — rigorously sourced.

results.title: AI Agent Benchmarks
results.summary: A saturation tracker for AI-agent benchmarks: what they measure, SOTA, headroom, the human gap and research priority.

results.title: How demanding is each exam in the world?
results.summary: An interactive benchmark comparing the academic demandingness of 18 university-entrance exams (PAES, PAU, IB, SAT, Gaokao, Suneung, JEE…) across 7 dimensions, with a world map, radars and ranking.

results.title: PAES vs PAU vs IB
results.summary: An interactive benchmark comparing the academic demandingness of Chile's PAES, Spain's PAU and the IB Diploma across 6 cognitive dimensions and 8 subjects, with radar charts.

results.title: The money World Cup
results.summary: Which national team punches above its squad value at the 2026 World Cup. A live efficiency index — points vs €-value — team by team.

results.title: World Surf Atlas
results.summary: An interactive atlas of 100+ world-class waves — wave direction (left / right / both), break type, level and month-by-month average wave height, plotted on a world map.

results.title: World Ski Atlas
results.summary: 130+ ski resorts on a world map — skiable km, runs by difficulty, snow quality, monthly snowfall, temperature and sun, plus lift-pass prices.

results.title: World Bike Park Atlas
results.summary: 40+ lift-served MTB / e-bike parks worldwide — trails by difficulty, vertical drop, km, season window and day-pass prices, on a world map.
